testcase.name: Scenario: extrusion-12 Distance tolerance dialog can be inspected and cancelled: tmp/oblikovati-ribbon-relocated.RcZVDl/pinned-checkout/features/solid-model/extrusion/extrusion.feature:116:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: extrusion-12 Distance tolerance dialog can be inspected and cancelled ✔> Given the MCAD Software is displaying a part in the solid modeling workspace ✔> And the viewport pointer is idle ✔ Given Edit Feature with Distance A 8 mm ✔ When Tolerance is opened from its dropdown ✔ Then Model Value is 8.000 mm and Type is Default ✔ And Precision, evaluated-size controls, Upper and Lower fields, Hole and Shaft fields are visible ✔ When the Type list is opened ✔ Then it offers Default, Basic, Symmetric, Deviation, Limits-Stacked, Limits-Linear, MAX, MIN, Limits/Fits-Stacked, Limits/Fits-Linear, Limits/Fits-Show Size Limits and Limits/Fits-Show Tolerance ✔ When the Type list is dismissed and Cancel is clicked ✔ Then the extrusion panel remains at Distance A 8 mm
